software_class: retrieval-grounded assistant over controlled knowledge sources

options.name: Local vector index
options.when_to_use: Corpus size and deployment constraints allow local retrieval.
options.when_not_to_use: Avoid when multi-user scaling or managed operations are required.
options.rationale: Keeps data flow transparent and simple.
options.tradeoffs: Scaling and operations remain local concerns.
options.risks: Index freshness can be manual without automation.

options.name: Managed vector store
options.when_to_use: Retrieval scale, uptime, or operations justify managed infrastructure.
options.when_not_to_use: Avoid when local privacy or simplicity is more important.
options.risks: Cost and data boundary risks need review.

options.name: Hybrid lexical and vector retrieval
options.when_to_use: Exact terms and semantic similarity both matter.
options.when_not_to_use: Avoid when one retrieval mode is clearly sufficient.
options.risks: Poor fusion can reduce answer quality.

options.name: Retrieval API service
options.when_to_use: Multiple applications need the same retrieval contract.
options.when_not_to_use: Avoid for a single lightweight assistant.
options.risks: API consumers can bypass answer safeguards.
